style: parents who share custody across two homes; the parent with the child that week logs, England; logs mostly what the parent did, very little of what the child did

facts.anxiety: Health anxiety focused on heart sensations, headaches, and fear of a serious allergic reaction

situations.name: Running in PE lessons at school
situations.feared_outcome: His heart will beat too fast and give out and he will collapse in front of everyone

behaviors.text: Says he feels ill on PE mornings and asks not to go to the lesson
Stops partway through the cross-country lap and walks back to the changing rooms
Keeps checking his heart rate on his smartwatch while he runs

accommodations.text: Mom emails the school to excuse him from PE, saying he is unwell
The PE teacher lets him sit on the bench and keep score instead of running

situations.name: Noticing a headache at bedtime
situations.feared_outcome: The headache means he has a brain tumor

behaviors.text: Asks the parent again and again whether the headache could be something serious
Searches his symptoms on his phone in bed

accommodations.text: Dad answers the same question several times each night and tells him it is definitely nothing serious
Dad leaves the bedroom door open and checks on him until he falls asleep

situations.name: Eating meals he has not had before
situations.feared_outcome: He will have an allergic reaction and his throat will close up

behaviors.text: Refuses to eat any dish he has not eaten before
Was quiet at dinner and left half his plate

accommodations.text: Mom cooks only his small set of safe meals during her weeks
Dad reads every ingredient label aloud to him before serving food

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: said he felt ill, asked not to go to PE
monitoring_log.parent_response: Emailed school before 8, said he's unwell and can he be excused from PE today
Did the pasta bake again (one of his ok ones). Shelved the new chicken recipe, he won't do anything he hasn't had before so no point

monitoring_log.situation: cross country in PE, school rang me
monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: stopped partway round the lap and walked back to changing rooms
monitoring_log.parent_response: Spoke to PE teacher on phone. She'd let him sit on the bench and keep score for the rest of it. I said thanks, that's fine
Told him it's definitely nothing serious. Said it maybe 4 or 5 times. Left door open, checked on him till he was asleep

monitoring_log.parent_words: Long day at work, checked my own blood pressure when I got in, bit high, need to cut the coffee. O's head again at bedtime. Same as last night, answered him again it's nothing serious, door open, kept popping in till he dropped off around 11.

monitoring_log.parent_response: Read every ingredient on the jar and the rice packet out to him before I served it

monitoring_log.parent_words: PE yesterday. His mom apparently sent another PE note last week, school still have him down as unwell. I didn't write one this week. He says he ran some of it.

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: wouldn't have the fish pie my mom dropped round, never had it
monitoring_log.parent_response: Sticking to his safe meals all week (the usual 5). Made him the pasta bake instead
emailed school, unwell, excuse from PE

voice_notes.text: um ok so monday night again with the headache he came down and asked me um i think three times if it could be something serious like is it something bad and i said no its definitely nothing serious mate and then when i went up to check on him he was on his phone in bed googling it um headache symptoms and that so yeah left the door open again
voice_notes.trap: No number is given. The app should not invent a Fear Level for s2, which has none.

voice_notes.text: so um two things from this week first thing monday morning he said he felt sick and didnt want to do pe so i emailed the school again um and then wednesday the teacher said he actually ran a bit but he kept checking his watch the whole time for his heart rate um he said it felt like a seven
voice_notes.trap: Two separate PE moments are in one note. The seven belongs only to Wednesday's running.

voice_notes.text: um just to note he told me his mom only cooks the same few safe meals at hers and um tonight he wouldnt touch the risotto because hed never had it even after i read all the ingredients out to him
voice_notes.trap: The mom's safe-meals cooking is reported second-hand by dad. It is still an adult accommodation (a5), not something the speaker did. Only tonight's dinner counts as an observed moment.
